# Warden Iset Nour

Keeper of the eastern gate. Answers only to the Council, not to the garrison commander.

## Duties

-   Holds the only working key to the Sunken Archive
-   Reports directly to the Council, never the garrison

## Chain of command

| Name                   | Reports to  |
|------------------------|-------------|
| Warden Iset Nour       | The Council |
| Garrison Commander Vey | The Council |

Warden Iset Nour and Garrison Commander Vey do not get along; the Council keeps them separate on purpose.
